SAP Share BDC Data Product to Snowflake — Interactive Clickthrough 10 Steps
Catalog & Marketplace Search
Step 1 of 10
Open the Catalog & Marketplace
From the BDC Cockpit home page, expand Catalog & Marketplace in the left navigation and click Search to browse data products.
Data Products Tab
Step 2 of 10
Open the Data Products Tab
In the Catalog & Marketplace, click the Data Products tab to filter the results and view available data products.
Internal Order
Step 3 of 10
Search and Select a Data Product
Use the filter panel on the left to narrow results. Find and click the Internal Order data product card to open it.
Scroll to Details ↓
Step 4 of 10
Open the Data Product
Review the data product overview: summary, system info (HE4_400_VP), data provider, and properties. Scroll down to see APIs and details.
Internal Order API
Step 5 of 10
Open the API Details
In the APIs section, click on the Internal Order API link to view its details and access the Share action.
Share
Step 6 of 10
Click Share
On the API detail page, click the Share button in the top-right corner to initiate sharing this data product to an external system.
Add Target
Step 7 of 10
Add a Target System
In the Manage Access dialog, click Add Target to select the Snowflake system you want to share this data product with.
bdc-connect-aae0aecc
Step 8 of 10
Select the Snowflake Target System
From the Target System dropdown, select your SAP BDC Connect for Snowflake instance (e.g. bdc-connect-aae0aecc) in the cf-eu10 region.
Share
Step 9 of 10
Confirm and Share
Review the selected target system, deployment region (cf-eu10), and System ID. Click Share to start sharing the data product to Snowflake.
Step 10 of 10
Share Successful
The data product is now being shared. The target system shows “Share in progress” and a toast confirms: “Creating a shared object in bdc-connect-aae0aecc. We will notify you when the process is complete.”
